luke.description: The Luke instance attached to this component.

parentSelector.description:
A parent selector that can be used to distinguish between multiple instances of a component within a page.
This can be leveraged to create 1-to-1 mappings between {@link UITestComponent}s so that functions
called on a component are limited only to the scope of that component in the UI.

spinner.description: The spinner that masks the component when data is loading

renderingSelectors.description:
An array of selectors used to determine whether the page/component exist or is rendered.  These selectors will be searched
for within the {@link #parentSelector}.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time that Luke will retry an action

fieldHelperMapping.description: Mappings of field types to their helper types

primaryGroupSelector.description:
Selector for the primary group in the field hierarchy
For example, a fieldSet for a filter panel, or a formSection for a form

secondaryGroupSelector.description:
Selector for the secondary group in the field hierarchy
For example, a fieldSetItem inside a fieldSet, or a formSectionItem inside a formSection

fieldGroupSelector.description: Selector for the element that represents a SDLFieldGroup

fieldGroupItemSelector.description:
Selector for the parent element that wraps a field input when it is
nested in a SDLFieldGroup

title: The base type that holds the common properties and functions for {@link LukeTestUiSdlForm} and {@link LukeTestUiSdlFilterPanel}.
name: LukeTestUiSdlFormBase
